title: Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff with Basmati
description: Seared sirloin strips in a smoky paprika, mushroom and tejföl sauce with a touch of Dijon, over basmati. Hob only, garlic-free.

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin (or rump), trimmed, cut into 1 cm strips

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice, add to a pan with the 280 ml water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover, turn to the lowest heat and cook 12 min. Take off the heat and rest 5 min, lid on.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.text: Pat the beef dry and season with ½ tsp salt and the pepper. Heat the oil in a wide pan on high heat. Sear the strips in 2 batches, 2 min per batch, so they brown rather than steam. Set aside.

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.text: Same pan, medium-high heat: add the butter and mushrooms with a pinch of salt. Cook 7 min until the liquid has gone and they're golden.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Add the onion and cook 5 min until soft.

steps.title: Paprika, flour and stock
steps.text: Stir in the paprika and flour for 1 min, then pour in the stock. Simmer 3 min until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Finish with tejföl
steps.text: Turn the heat to low. Mix the tejföl with the Dijon and a spoonful of the hot sauce, then stir it into the pan. Return the beef and its juices and warm 2 min — don't let it boil or the tejföl can split. Taste for salt and scatter over the parsley.

steps.title: Plate and split
steps.text: Rice 135 g / 30 g uncooked weight (Matthias / Nyuszika); stroganoff roughly two-thirds / one-third.

notes: No protein bridge needed. Chestnut (barna csiperke) mushrooms are sometimes out on Kifli — plain white ones work fine.
